# Eigin

> Eigin is a personal AI agent built to be private, safe, and under your control.

The website is available in English and Danish. The trust page describes data handling and model choices. The roadmap distinguishes available features from planned work.

## Product

- [Eigin](https://eigin.ai/en/): Product overview and iPhone beta access.
- [Trust](https://eigin.ai/en/trust/): Storage, cloud requests, permissions, and privacy.
- [Roadmap](https://eigin.ai/en/roadmap/): Current development and planned features.
- [News](https://eigin.ai/en/news/): Published announcements and updates.
- [Support](https://eigin.ai/en/support/): Help with the app.

## Project

- [Source code](https://code.eigin.ai/dev/eigin): Open-source repository, issues, and contributions.
- [Contact](https://eigin.ai/en/contact/): Company and press contact.

## Optional

- [Dansk](https://eigin.ai/da/): Danish-language website.
- [Privacy](https://eigin.ai/en/privacy/): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://eigin.ai/en/terms/): Terms of service.
